pli-tv-bu-pm:1.1: uposathakaraṇato pubbe navavidhaṃ pubbekiccaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti. taṇṭhānasammajjanañca tattha padīpujjalanañca āsanapaññapanañca pānīyaparibhojanīyūpaṭṭhapanañca chandārahānaṃ bhikkhunaṃ chandāharaṇañca tesaññeva akatuposathānaṃ pārisuddhiyāpi āharaṇañca utukkhānañca bhikkhugaṇanā ca bhikkhunīnamovādo cāti. tattha purimāni cattāri bhikkhunaṃ vattaṃ jānantehi ārāmikehipi bhikkhūhipi katāni pariniṭṭhitāni honti. chandāharaṇa pārisuddhi āharaṇāni pana imissaṃ sīmāyaṃ hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā nisinnānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāvato natthi. utukkhānaṃ nāma etattakaṃ atikkantaṃ, ettakaṃ avasiṭṭhanti evaṃ utuācikkhanaṃ; utūnīdha pana sāsane hemantagimhavassānānaṃ vasena tīṇi honti. ayaṃ hemantotu, asmiñca utumhi aṭṭha uposathā, iminā pakkhena eko uposatho sampatto satta uposathā avasiṭṭhā iti evaṃ sabbehi āyasmantehi utukkhānaṃ dhāretabbaṃ. bhikkhugaṇanā nāma imasniṃ uposathaggela uposathatthāya sannipatitā bhikkhū ettakāti bhikkhūnaṃ gaṇanā. imasmimpana uposathagge cattāro bhikkhū sannipatitā honti iti sabberi āyasmantehi ibhikkhugaṇanāpi dhāretabbā. bhikkhunīnamovādo pana idāni tāsaṃ natthitāya natthi. iti sakaraṇokāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā nikkaraṇokāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭaṭhitattā evantaṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti. niṭṭhate ca pubbakicce sace so divaso cātuddasī paṇṇarasī sāmaggīnamaññataro yathājja uposatho paṇṇaraso , yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅghuposathārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmāyaṃ ṭhitā, tesañca vikālabhojanādi. vasena vatthusabhāgāpattiyo ce na vijjanti; tesañca hatthapāse hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbo koci vajjanīyapuggalo ce natthi. evantaṃ uposathakammaṃ imehi catūhi lakkhaṇehi saṅgahitaṃ pattakallaṃ nāma hoti kātuṃ yuttarūpaṃ uposathakammassa pattakallattaṃ viditvā idāni kariyamāno uposatho saṅghena anumānetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-pm:4.1: pubbakaraṇapubbakiccāni samāpetvā imassa nisinnassa bhikkhusaṅghassa anumatiyā pāṭimokkhaṃ uddesituṃ ajjhesanaṃ karomi.
pli-tv-bu-pm:5.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakalilaṃ, saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya, pāṭimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.4: taṃ sabbeva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma manasikaroma.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.8: yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evamevaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anussāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.9: yo pana bhikkhu yāvatatiyaṃ anussāviyamāne saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ nāvikareyya, sampajānamusāvādassa hoti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.10: sampajānamusāvādo kho panāyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā;
pli-tv-bu-pm:6.11: tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddharāpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:8.1: tatrime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:9.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikākhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:10.1: yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:10.2: yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti; tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ āditayamāno,
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.1: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.2: ambho purisa kiṃ tuyhiminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, matante jīvitā seyyoti;
pli-tv-bu-pm:11.3: iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya;
pli-tv-bu-pm:12.1: yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ attūpanāyikaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanaṃ samudācareyya iti jānāmi, iti passāmīti;
pli-tv-bu-pm:12.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhiyamāno vā asamanuggāhiyamāno vā āpanno visuddhāpekkho evaṃ vadeyya ajānamevaṃ āvuso avacaṃ ' jānāmi ' apassaṃ ' passāmi ' tucchaṃ musā vilapinti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.1: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.2: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:13.3: yathā pure; tathā pacchā; pārājiko hoti asaṃvāvo.
pli-tv-bu-pm:14.1: ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:16.1: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya, hatthagāhaṃ vā veṇigāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:17.1: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya, yathātaṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methunūpasañhitāhi; saṅghādaseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:18.1: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ, yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ barhmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyāti methunūpasañhitena, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:19.1: yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthīmatiṃ jāyattane vā jārattane vā antamaso taṃkhaṇikāyapi, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.1: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā; tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ; dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ sattantarā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.2: bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya: tehi bhikkhū vatthuṃ desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:20.3: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññacikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.1: mahallakampana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya:
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.2: tehi bhikkhūhi vatthuṃ desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:21.3: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:22.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:22.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhiyamāno vā, asamanuggāhiyamāno vā, amūlakañceva taṃ adhakaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:23.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñci desaṃ selamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyanti
pli-tv-bu-pm:23.2: tato aparena samayena samanuggāhiyamāno vā, asamanuggāhiyamāno vā, añña bhāgiyañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, koci deso lesamatto upādinno bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.1: yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā samādāya paggayha tiṭiṭhayya. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.2: mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samadāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi;
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.3: sametāyasumā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodanāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.4: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya;
pli-tv-bu-pm:24.5: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajajeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.1: tasseva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā, eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.2: mā āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacutthā
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.3: dhammavādī ceso bhikkhu, vinayavādī ceso bhikkhu,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.4: amhākañceso bhikkhu, chandañca ruciñca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākampetaṃ khamatīti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.7: na ceso bhikkhu dhammāvādī, na ceso bhikkhu vinayavādī,
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.9: sametāyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodanāmo avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.10: evañca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya;
pli-tv-bu-pm:25.11: yāvatatiyañce samamubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.1: bhikkhu paneva dubbacajātiko hoti, uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ karoti
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.2: mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.5: mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyameva āyasmā attānaṃ karotu,
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.6: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena, bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena;
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.7: evaṃ saṃvaḍḍhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā, yadidaṃ aññaññevacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenāti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.8: evavañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya;
pli-tv-bu-pm:26.9: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.1: bhikkhu paneva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca.
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.3: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca. kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca; pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alante idha vāsenāti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.4: evañca lo bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.5: chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosa gāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū; tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentīti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.7: mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino, na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino, na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino, na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino;
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.8: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alante idha vāsenāti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.9: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya;
pli-tv-bu-pm:27.10: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.1: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā; nava paṭhamāpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā;
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.2: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvatihaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti; tāvatihaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.3: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttariṃ chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.4: ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu, yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhatha abbhetabbo;
pli-tv-bu-pm:28.5: ekenapi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito te ca bhikkhū gārayhā: ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
pli-tv-bu-pm:29.1: ime kho panāyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.1: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya; tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.2: tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.3: nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā;
pli-tv-bu-pm:30.4: yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo;
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.1: na heva kho pana paṭicchannaṃ āsanaṃ hoti nālaṃkammaniyaṃ, alañca kho hoti mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsituṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.2: yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpe āsine mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya; tamenaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.3: dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyay saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.4: nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo saṅghādisesena vā pācittiyena vā,
pli-tv-bu-pm:31.5: yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo;
pli-tv-bu-pm:32.1: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-pm:33.1: ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-pm:34.1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine, dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ, taṃ atikkāmayato, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:35.1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine, ekarattampi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammatiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.1: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine, bhikkhuno paneva akāsacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabhaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.3: no cassa pāripūri, māsaparamantena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:36.4: tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya satiyāpi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:37.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:38.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:39.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:39.2: tatthāyaṃ samayo: acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo,
pli-tv-bu-pm:40.1: tañce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhumpavāreyya, santaruttaraparamantena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ, tato ce uttariṃ sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.1: bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpanaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.2: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmīti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.3: tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appāvārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:41.4: sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpanena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehīti
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.1: bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa ubhinnaṃ aññātakānaṃ gahapatīnaṃ vā gahapatānīnaṃ vā paccekacīvaracetāpanā upakkhaṭā honti
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.2: imehi mayaṃ paccekacīvaracetāpanehi paccekacīvarāni cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarehi acchādessāmāti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.3: tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:42.4: sādhu vata maṃ āyasmanto imehi paccekacīvaracetāpanehi evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādekatha ubhoṅa santā ekenāti
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.1: bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.2: iminā cīvaracetāpanena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehīti;
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.3: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.4: idaṃ kho bhante āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpananti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.5: tena bhikkhunā so dūto evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.6: na kho mayaṃ āvuso cīvaracetāpanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, cīvarañca kho mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma kālena kappiyanti;
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.7: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.9: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.11: so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.12: yaṃ kho bhante āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā; upasaṅkamatu āyasmā kālena cīvarena taṃ acchādessatīti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.13: cīvaratthikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro upasaṅkamitvā dvittikkhattuṃ codetabbo sāretabbo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.15: dvittikkhattaṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.16: no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakakhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇahībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.17: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattuparamaṃ tuṇhībhūto addissa tiṭṭhamāno cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, iccetaṃ kusasaṃ; no ce abhinipphādeyya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.18: tato ce uttariṃ vāyamamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.19: no ce abhinipphādeyya, yatassa cīvaracetāpanaṃ ābhataṃ, tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ, dūto vā pāhetabbo
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.20: yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpanaṃ pahiṇittha, na tantassa bhikkhuno kiñci atathaṃ anubhoti,
pli-tv-bu-pm:43.21: yuñjantāyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassīti:
pli-tv-bu-pm:44.1: yo pana bhikkhu santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggīyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:45.1: yo pana bhikkhu suddhākāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ sanuthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:46.1: navampana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā sudadhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-pm:46.2: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomamānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

pli-tv-bu-pm:48.1: nisīdanasanthatampana bhikkhanā kārayamāmena purāṇasentassa sāmantā sugatividatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya,
pli-tv-bu-pm:48.2: anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-pm:49.2: ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā hāretabbāni, asante hārake,

pli-tv-bu-pm:54.1: dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo, taṃ atikkāmayato, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

pli-tv-bu-pm:57.1: māso seso gimhānanti bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, aḍḍhamāso seso gimhānanti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ;
